learning_outcomes.text: Students who have successfully completed this module know the basic structures and processes in the automotive industry.
Students who have successfully completed this module have the necessary basic knowledge of the automotive industry and understand the connections between automotive technology and economics.
Students are able to evaluate and explain basic relationships in the automotive industry.
They know the approaches in automotive corporate management and can demonstrate the differences and parallels to other sectors of the economy.
In addition, students apply subject-specific skills and abilities in familiar and unfamiliar contexts.
Students know the basics of the automotive industry as a supplement to the technical focus in engineering studies.
Based on the acquired knowledge, students can integrate economic contexts into their technical work.
Students can communicate and plausibly present automotive economic contexts to employees and superiors in discussions.
Students can assess and evaluate existing and future challenges in the automotive industry.

assessment_rules: The graded examination is a term paper. The term paper involves a project work over the semester with milestone and final presentations, as well as a project report of at least 30 pages.
bibliography: Diez, W.: Grundlagen der Automobilwirtschaft: Das Standardwerk der Automobilbranche; Springer-Verlag
